text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Traaacen! Acaaadeeemiiic! Cheeerleeeaaadiiing! Squaaad!!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Osuuu!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We, Tracen Cheer Squad, assemble for grand purpose of upcoming Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Osuuu!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To every Uma Musume contesting in events—we unleash fiercest cheers so all reach absolute peaks!!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Osuuu!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Toward that grand endeavor, we shall—!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Deploy Hyper Power DX Cheer Gear! Wearing this aids deep breath control! Plus built-in mega mic!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, WHAAAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Grand surprise, wasn't it?! Keeping secret from entire squad proved worthy triumph!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Secret means no one could stop crazy idea! What even made Pearl-neesan put on?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No different from fireworks or disco glitter! Flashy spectacle fuels spirit! Sense of romance, no?! Now then, Pearl-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: FiiiiiII~~ Iiight OooOOoo~~~~ Oon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Lost track of what's happening here...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haaalt right there, King Halo! You messed with campus PA speakers without permit?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Disciplinary Committee got floods of complaints! Speakers cut out, then bizarre singing blasted... Wait, what even IS thaaat?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gah, Disciplinary Committee cracked code fast... Squad, tactical retreat nooow!! Pull baaack~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah... man, what is wrong with these people... Can't keep up...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Anyway, as heard, Tracen Cheer Squad got formed for Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Fan Appreciation Festival happens spring and autumn. Spring is basically Sports Day, autumn is Culture Fest.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: During Spring Fest, Uma Musume join sports events all over campus to entertain visiting fans.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So this year, Cheer Squad squad leader hyping events up is King. Pearl-san and me got roped along too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Right, Pearl-san?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Spot on! Flawless summary as always, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Could Pearl-san stop enabling her though...? King lets nonsense go straight to head...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, why? Ideas weren't half bad. Plus, mindset is—
(Ding Ding! Beep Beep!! Boom, Pee Pee Pee-!! Pow Pow! Pee Pee-! Boom Shakalaka Boom Boom!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
～～!? W-what on earth is that music...?
Don't tell me, this is also...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aahhh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: W-what in the world is this!? Who is causing such a ruckus—!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This week, the plan is to have people from outside the academy
come and join the "Cheerleading Squad Practice Session". I get
that they're super motivated, but still...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That flashy costume and music... and last time they
went and made a giant firecracker... Haaa~~ why are squad leaders
always doing such showy things...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I ask what she's thinking, she doesn't seem like the
type to give me an honest answer anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nature! Would you like to know the answer!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uu-woaaah!? Pearl-san!? M-my heart nearly jumped out of my chest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Apologies! I simply caught the sound of someone who seemed a
bit lost, and my body moved before I even knew it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, regarding King—it all started about a month ago.
At least, based on what I witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That day when the academy handed out the
sign-up forms for the festival events, King——
